menu_prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: full-screen background for Mafia1986, a landscape Android game set in 1920s Chicago.
Primary request: Create a beautiful cohesive handcrafted 16-bit pixel art background, wide 16:9 composition. Chicago street at night during Prohibition, brick buildings, elevated railway silhouette, a period automobile parked by a warmly lit speakeasy entrance, rain-slick paving with restrained amber reflections. Atmospheric midnight navy shadows, muted teal, amber windows and subtle antique gold. Crisp clearly visible square pixel clusters, limited palette, no smooth painted gradients, no photorealism. Art should feel like a polished modern pixel adventure game.
Composition: environment occupies the entire image edge to edge; memorable street vista in the left and center, quieter dark space on the right suitable for a compact menu panel; avoid essential detail in the outer edges because phone ratios crop. Human-eye perspective, cinematic depth.
Constraints: background art only, no UI, frames, borders, letters, signs with words, logos, watermark or prominent characters. No modern objects. Opaque background. Output a single landscape image.
